title: Fixed the `fixedColumnsEnd` freeze line, which moved by 1px at the end of the horizontal scroll, showed twice where a column lined up with the frozen columns, and cut the selection edge on the first of them. A selection that scrolling lines up with the `fixedColumnsStart`, `fixedColumnsEnd`, or `fixedRowsTop` area now draws its edge on the freeze line, as on any other gridline.
